T: No place like home. No crullers like Auntie Em's.
D: A Kansas farm girl is swept by a tornado to the land of Oz and follows the yellow brick road to the wizard.
P: Serve the snacks when Auntie Em hands out the fresh crullers on the farm.
S: Auntie Em offering the farmhands fresh crullers
Choux dough piped into twisted rings, fried at 180C until golden, dipped in a honey glaze while warm.

Crisp red apple wedges with a warm salted caramel dip, crushed roasted peanuts and a dusting of cinnamon for dunking. Melt 100g brown sugar with 60g butter, stirring for 2 minutes, then pour in 125ml cream and simmer 3 minutes until thick. Take off the heat and stir in half a teaspoon of salt. Cut 4 red apples into wedges and toss in lemon juice so they don't brown. Pour the warm caramel into a bowl, scatter with 60g crushed roasted peanuts and a pinch of cinnamon and serve with the apples.
Homemade lollipops of sugar and glucose boiled to 150C, swirled with colours and set on sticks.
M: Chicken pieces soaked in buttermilk, dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 170C until crisp, with mash and gravy.
Emerald City pesto penne with broccoli

Penne cooked with broccoli and peas in the same pot, tossed with basil pesto, parmesan and lemon until bright green. Cook 400g penne in salted water, adding 1 head broccoli in small florets and 1 cup frozen peas for the last 3 minutes. Drain, keeping a cup of the water. Toss with 190g basil pesto, the zest and juice of 1 lemon and 50g grated parmesan, adding pasta water until glossy. Toast 40g pine nuts in a dry pan. Serve topped with the pine nuts, extra parmesan and a handful of basil leaves.
W: Raspberry jelly set in glasses with raspberries and a sparkle of edible glitter, topped with cream.
K: Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup mixed with pineapple juice and grated ginger, topped with soda water over ice with a pineapple wedge. Simmer 80g caster sugar with 80ml water and 1 tsp grated ginger for 2 minutes, then cool and strain. Mix the syrup with the juice of 4 lemons and 400ml pineapple juice. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, divide the mix between them and top with 400ml soda water. Finish each with a fresh pineapple wedge on the rim.

s.note: Auntie Em offering the farmhands fresh crullers
s.how: Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g flour, then beat in 4 eggs. Pipe twisted rings onto squares of baking paper and fry at 180C until golden. Dip in a glaze of icing sugar, honey and a splash of milk.

Boil 200g sugar, 80ml glucose syrup and 80ml water to 150C without stirring. Pour into two pans, tint each a different colour, then pour small rounds onto baking paper, swirling colours. Press a stick into each and leave to harden.

m.how: Soak 8 chicken drumsticks in buttermilk overnight. Dredge in flour seasoned with smoked paprika and salt. Fry at 170C for 12 minutes until crisp. Serve with buttery mash from 1kg potatoes and gravy made with chicken stock. No place like it.

w.how: Make up a packet of raspberry jelly and pour into glasses with a few raspberries in each. Chill for 3 hours until set. Dust with edible glitter so it sparkles like ruby slippers, then top with a little whipped cream.

d.how: Simmer 80g caster sugar with 80ml water and 1 tsp grated ginger for 2 minutes, then cool and strain. Mix the syrup with the juice of 4 lemons and 400ml pineapple juice. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, divide the mix between them and top with 400ml soda water. Finish each with a fresh pineapple wedge on the rim.
